english.title: Person not grantee / owner / agent / employee place implement / apparatus / thing prejudicial shellfish etc
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), not being a grantee or an agent or employee of the grantees or the owner or an agent or employee of the owner, knowingly placed an implement, apparatus or thing, namely **(..SPECIFY IMPLEMENT, APPARATUS OR THING..), prejudicial or likely to be prejudicial to shellfish, the bed or fishery, other than for a lawful purpose of navigation or anchorage,

(A)_[within the limits of the area of a fishery with respect to which the right of several fishery was conferred]_
(B)_[in part of the area of a fishery described for the purposes of that section in an order conferring the right of several fishery]_
(C)_[within the limits of a private shellfish bed]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 7(4)(d) of the Sea Fisheries (Shellfish) Act 1967.
english.pointstoprove:

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
